description.value:
Some scouts believe the surest path to victory is understanding: study your enemy long enough, and their strengths become irrelevant next to the weaknesses you've found. Followers of the Slayer Technique turn observation into execution, reading a foe's defenses in an instant and striking exactly where it hurts most.

Armored and unshaken, a Slayer closes the distance others would avoid, marking a single target and refusing to let it go. What begins as reconnaissance becomes a hunter's bond; the more they study their prey, the more precisely they can end the fight, until even the most fearsome opponent finds itself outmatched by its own exposed flaws.
